reviews.title: Works perfectly on a 2008 HP PC Win 7
reviews.comment:
After taking the front panel off the PC and disconnecting the data and power cableS, I slid the old DVD out of the front of the PC.  This drive was exactly the same size as the old one and slid the back in from the front.  I then attached the 2 cables and placed one screw in the side to secure the drive to the PC.
I booted the PC and Windows recognized the drive without displaying any dialogs boxes. I burned a DVD and a CD and they both played perfectly.
